topic.title: How to Expand Abbreviations Once per Chapter

body.p:
In large documents, readers often jump directly to a specific chapter. Therefore, it can be useful to show the full form of an abbreviation the first time it is used in each chapter, not only the first time it is used in the document. To add this functionality, use an Oxygen Publishing Template and follow these steps:
In the newly created folder, create an XSL file (for example, merged2html5Extension.xsl) with a custom template that matches each acronym:<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <xsl:stylesheet xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:opentopic="http://www.idiominc.com/opentopic" exclude-result-prefixes="xs opentopic" version="3.0">
<!-- Terms grouped by (closest topic, keyref); the key keeps it fast on big documents --> <xsl:key name="term-per-chapter" match="*[contains(@class, ' topic/term ')][@keyref][not(ancestor::opentopic:map)]" use="concat( generate-id(ancestor::*[contains(@class, ' topic/topic ')][last()]), '|', @keyref)"/>
<xsl:template match="*" mode="getMatchingAcronym"> <xsl:param name="m_matched-target" as="element()?"/> <xsl:param name="m_keys"/>
<xsl:variable name="k" select="concat( generate-id(ancestor::*[contains(@class, ' topic/topic ')][last()]), '|', @keyref)"/>
<xsl:choose> <xsl:when test=". is key('term-per-chapter', $k)[1]"> <!-- First occurrence in this chapter: full form (surface form, or glossterm) --> <xsl:apply-templates select="." mode="getMatchingSurfaceForm"> <xsl:with-param name="m_matched-target" select="$m_matched-target"/> <xsl:with-param name="m_keys" select="$m_keys"/> </xsl:apply-templates> </xsl:when> <xsl:otherwise> <xsl:next-match> <xsl:with-param name="m_matched-target" select="$m_matched-target"/> <xsl:with-param name="m_keys" select="$m_keys"/> </xsl:next-match> </xsl:otherwise> </xsl:choose> </xsl:template>
</xsl:stylesheet>To expand abbreviations once per topic instead of once per chapter, replace [last()] with [1] in both the "term-per-chapter" key and the "k" variable.
Open the template descriptor file associated with your publishing template (the .opt file) and specify the XSLT stylesheet created in the previous step for the com.oxygenxml.pdf.css.xsl.merged2html5 XSLT extension point:<publishing-template> ... <pdf> ... <xslt> <extension id="com.oxygenxml.pdf.css.xsl.merged2html5" file="xslt/merged2html5Extension.xsl"/> </xslt>
